methodology: The decomposition process involves identifying independent, technically specific, and implementable requirements, features, behaviors, and constraints. The original research topic and the generated specification are analyzed to extract these atomic units. Each unit represents a single, unambiguous aspect of the design. The criteria for each unit are: independence (self-contained), specificity (technically precise), and implementability (can be realized as a single requirement).
mindtraced_atomic_units: Implement a Moore state machine in Verilog
OFF state, j=0: stay in OFF
OFF state, j=1: transition to ON
ON state, k=0: stay in ON
ON state, k=1: transition to OFF
spec_atomic_units: Inputs j, k, clk, reset do not directly influence output through combinational logic
Output changes synchronously with rising edge of clk
Reset signal forces state to OFF on rising clk edge
State transitions: OFF --j=0--> OFF, OFF --j=1--> ON, ON --k=0--> ON, ON --k=1--> OFF
Sequential circuit with one state register
State transitions on rising edge of clk
out is a direct reflection of the current state (Moore machine)
